text:
Asking rents in Berlin stand at a median of 15.18 €/m² (2026-06), down 2.0% on the year and +29.5% over five years. That ranks Berlin #6 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 98% above the 2022 average contract rent of 7.67 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 911 € a month in cold rent, 20.9% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 26 days and 38% are gone within a week; with 1.3% market-active vacancy and +3.9% population growth over five years, the market looks tight.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 16.24 €/m² (+7.0%), with an 80% range of 15.42 to 16.73 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
